subject: The week in luxury hospitality: Gstaad, Merano, Paris
headline: The Alps open the season
intro: Good morning. Last week, the Alps set the tone. In Gstaad, Dona Bertarelli is reported to have sold The Park Gstaad to George Prokopiou, ahead of its reopening as a Four Seasons in mid-2027; the sale has not been confirmed ([Billionaires.Africa, 21 Nov](https://www.billionaires.africa/2026/11/21/swiss-billionaire-dona-bertarelli-reportedly-sells-gstaad-hotel-for-up-to-500-million/)). A few streets away, the Gstaad Palace prepares its 114th winter season from 15 December, after around €6.9 million of works ([La Revue des Hôtels](https://larevuedeshotels.com/en/gstaad-palace-hotel-switzerland-reopens-15-december-after-6-9-million)). In South Tyrol, the city of Merano honoured Zinédine Zidane, a guest of Palace Merano since 1996, for the hotel's 120th anniversary ([il Dolomiti](https://www.ildolomiti.it/cronaca/2026/arriva-zinedine-zidane-la-leggenda-del-calcio-incontra-calciatrici-e-calciatori-delle-squadre-locali-e-la-citta-di-merano-omaggia-zizou)).

In Paris, Rosewood's Hôtel de Crillon named Édouard Delavaux managing director ([eTurboNews, 21 Nov](https://eturbonews.com/global-hotel-hospitality-news-november-15-21-2026/)), and Ennismore signed the first Hyde hotel in France, on the Seine ([Journal des Palaces](https://www.journaldespalaces.com/en/pressrelease-80143-france-hotel-opening-ennismore-makes-its-mark-on-the-seine-by-signing-the-first-hyde-hotel-in-france.html)). In Dubai, LPM is getting ready to open LPM-Sur-Mer, its first beach concept, at Jumeirah Beach Hotel on 28 November ([What's On](https://whatson.ae/2026/11/an-lpm-beach-concept-is-opening-in-dubai-this-november/)).
